statement.zh: Fieldiana 2013：大型平台丘与沉陷圆形广场配对的模式在公元前第三千纪已出现；卡瓦列特、波韦尼尔等可见 U 形布局倾向。
statement.en: Fieldiana 2013: pairing of large mounds with sunken circular plazas is present by the third millennium BCE; U-shaped layouts appear at sites such as Caballete and Porvenir.
